messages:
Raj - sales: Quick presales headsup — CloudBank POC failing when streaming from their corporate desktop app. Both TS and Python SDKs drop after ~15s with ECONNRESET. They need triage before next demo.

Ava - solutions: Can we get exact SDK versions and a minimal log snippet? Also ask whether they route through a proxy appliance (TLS inspect / NTLM / SSO).

Raj - sales: They run TS v1.4.7 and Py v1.4.7. Customer log: `Error: socket hang up
    at TLSSocket.onConnectEnd (node:_tls_wrap:1429:16)`
Python: `ChunkedEncodingError: ("Connection broken: IncompleteRead(0 bytes read)",)`. They confirm a corporate proxy with TLS inspection and occasional 407 reauth events.

Diego - eng: Pattern matches proxy-caused stream resets (ALPN/TLS inspection or reauth tearing h2 streams). On our side req-id cbk-22 shows continuous token output for >2m. We didn't close.

Marta - infra: Agreed. Recommend quick experiments for customer: 1) curl --http2 test, 2) curl --http1.1 --no-keepalive test, 3) openssl s_client -alpn h2 -connect api.redwood.ai:443. Ask them to check proxy logs around the timestamp for 407 or header rewrites.

Ava - solutions: For immediate workaround: set env REDWOOD_FORCE_HTTP1=1 (TS) or REDWOOD_HTTP_VERSION=1 (Py) and increase streamingKeepaliveMs / socket timeout to 60000. That forces chunked h1 which most middleboxes handle better. Provide example snippet.

Diego - eng: Snippet for TS: `process.env.REDWOOD_FORCE_HTTP1='1'; const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, streamingKeepaliveMs: 60000 });` For Python: `export REDWOOD_HTTP_VERSION=1` and set read timeout to 60s.

Raj - sales: CloudBank ran the http1.1 curl and kept streaming 3+ minutes. They asked if forcing http1.1 affects production routing or concurrency.

Diego - eng: Its per-client only, hosted endpoints keep supporting h2. HTTP/1.1 can mean more TCP connections under heavy concurrency but fine for POC. For production recommend Dedicated/Private or proxy rule to exempt our host.

Marta - infra: I'll add a short KB entry under presales: "TLS inspection / NTLM -> preferHttp1 workaround" and add a log tag `x-rw-stream:1` to help support find long-lived streams. Opening infra ticket.

Ava - solutions: Also supply a one-line security FAQ: "Redwood terminates TLS using standard cloud-provider stacks (TLS 1.2/1.3) and does not employ custom TLS fingerprinting."

support-bot: Note created: presales/POC-CLOUDBANK-374321  http1-workaround documented.

Raj - sales: Sending steps now and offering a 7-day Dedicated trial to validate without their proxy. Will close once they confirm demo passes. :thumbsup:
